description: This file defines a React functional component 'Rating' for rendering star-based rating visuals, including partial (half) stars, and an internal 'Star' component for individual star icons. It handles display of full, half, and empty stars based on a numeric rating, with optional count display and size variants.

methods.name: Rating
methods.description: React component that displays a star-based rating visualization, with optional count display and size options.

methods.name: Star
methods.description: Internal component that renders a star SVG icon based on the variant: full, half, or empty.
